content.text: Inversion of Control is a common phenomenon that you come across when extending frameworks.

This paragraph is ordinary text to see how pages break. The PDF keeps at least two lines of a paragraph on each side of a break, headings never stay alone at the bottom of a page, and images stay with their captions. When you download an article from ReadIn as a PDF it should be clean and easy to read and to print, with English and Arabic (العربي) in the right places and numbers like 3.14, 1,000 and 2026 in Western digits.

A second paragraph: performance matters, but readability matters more. Write code the next person understands, and use clear names like CalculateInvoiceTotal instead of Calc. When you write tests, make each one check a single behaviour and name it after it, like Order_is_cancelled_when_payment_fails.
